# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student


def _check(students: List[Student]) -> None:
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students for contact sheet")
    for item in students:
        if not item.email:
            name = item.display_name
            raise ValueError(f"no email: {name}")


def _line(row: tuple, widths: List[int]) -> str:
    cells = zip(row, widths)
    return "  ".join(t.ljust(n) for t, n in cells).rstrip()


def _pad(cells: List[tuple]) -> List[str]:
    sizes = [max(map(len, col)) for col in zip(*cells)]
    return [_line(row, sizes) for row in cells]


def _name(student: Student) -> str:
    return student.display_name


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    _check(students)
    ordered = sorted(students, key=_name)
    return _pad([
        (item.display_name, item.section, item.email)
        for item in ordered
    ])
EOF

EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.models import Student


def _stud(last, first, mail="a@x.test"):
    return Student("idnum", last, first, "7A", mail)


def _sample():
    return contact_rows([
        _stud("Zedd", "Amy", "z@x.test"),
        _stud("Abel", "Bob", "b@x.test")
    ])


class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted(self):
        first = _sample()[0]
        self.assertTrue(first.startswith("Abel, Bob"))

    def test_aligned(self):
        rows = _sample()
        for mark in ("7A", "@x.test"):
            left = rows[0].index(mark)
            self.assertEqual(left, rows[1].index(mark))

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        nomail = [_stud("Abel", "Bob", None)]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Abel, Bob"):
            contact_rows(nomail)

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
